cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Studenti budou schopni kvalifikovaně posoudit zásahy do prostředí ovlivňující diverzitu živočichů, pochopí,jak fatální vliv může mít nevhodný způsob hospodaření v hodnotných, přírodě blízkých biotopech na populace bezobratlých živočichů. Studenti si uvědomí hodnotu a nutnost zachování těchto, často horkých míst biodiverzity v České Republice.

What is habitat management and why is it necessary? (allowance 1/2)

en.label: a.
en.content: Reasons and principles of Small scale natural protected areas conservation

en.label: b.
en.content: Successional stage conservation, principles and possibilities

en.label: c.
en.content: Habitat management for various groups of animals focused on protected species. Possible conflicts
Management plan (allowance 1/2)

en.label: a.
en.content: Setting objectives, management plan and monitoring. Invertebrates as bioindicators

en.label: b.
en.content: legislature
Grazing and effects of grazing on protected fauna (allowance 1/2)

en.label: a.
en.content: Grazing animals and their grazing process. The timing and duration of grazing, intenzity of grazing. Levels of control over grazing. Use of anti-parasitic drugs, controlling unwanted plants

en.label: b.
en.content: Mowing and its effect on protected species. Machine cutting versus hand cutting. Timing. Biomass storage.
Examples of management techniques - expert lecture (allowance 1/2)
Special management techniques I. (allowance 1/2)

en.label: a.
en.content: Forest grazing, coppice management. Coppice with standards (Middlewald). Effects on protected invertebrates. Expert studies examples of last decades.
Special management techniques II. (allowance 1/2)

en.label: a.
en.content: Burning, blasting, gaps. The other techniques of soil disturbance. Effect on protected invertebrates.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Students will be able to explore propriety of habitat management and its effect to fauna diversity (invertebrate fauna diversity included). They will understand fatal effect of unsuitable habitat management in natural like habitats. Students will realize necessity of existence this hot spots of biodiversity in the Czech Republic.
